message: config.policy.cooldown.ignore in composer.json lists acme/tools, which Composer exempts from the release-age delay, but cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json does not exclude it
fix: Remove "acme/tools" from config.policy.cooldown.ignore in composer.json and run composer update --lock, or add composer:acme/tools to cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json
